name: Cron Service UI
description: Provides UI for the Cron Service module.
project_description: Cron Service UI is the optional admin submodule of Cron Service Manager. It adds an overview page at /admin/config/system/cron/services (local task under the core Cron settings) that lists every registered cron service, its schedule / forced state, and a 'Force on next Cron run' operation. Forcing routes through a confirm form (ForceServiceForm) which calls CronServiceManager::forceNextExecution(); the service is not run immediately but bypasses schedule checks on the next cron run. Both routes require the 'access cron service ui' permission (marked restrict access). It provides no config or entities of its own.
